nodes.question: What is the role of radiology societies in addressing climate change impacts on healthcare?
nodes.answer: Radiology societies advocate for urgent, impactful, and measurable changes in healthcare delivery by engaging members, policymakers, industry partners, and patients.

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Climate change adaptation strategies|Resilient healthcare systems_qna_001
nodes.label: Ethics and regulation
nodes.question: What actions can professional societies take to mitigate the environmental impact of radiological practice?
nodes.answer: Radiological societies need to advocate for urgent, impactful, and measurable changes, prioritize research and education on climate and environmental threats, and work on improving access to care.
